verdict.rationale: Marlin is an autonomous research agent, so it is fair to ask whether its runs or research plans can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back; the axis applies. The evidence shows only one-shot autonomous runs that start after a brief scoping exchange and can be cancelled mid-execution. Cancellation is an adjacent control, not versioning or rollback, and nothing documents saving, versioning, reviewing changes to, or restoring prior automation configurations.
